# dsh-plugin-notify
中文 | English
Session-state notifications for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH): a **WxPusher push** plus a **real browse
r notification** — with sound and `requireInteraction` — whenever a session stops, exits with an err
or, or asks you a question. Everything is configured from a native settings page (设置 → 通知 / Settings
question. Everything is configured from a native settings page (设置 → 通知 / Settings → Notifications).
- **Two independent channels, one payload.** The Host detects the transition once and delivers the s

ame content to WxPusher and to every open browser page.
- **Real system notifications.** `new Notifi
cation(...)` with a PNG icon, an optional WebAudio chime, and `requireInteraction` so the banner sta

ys until you dismiss it.
- **Native settings page.** A `settings.section` page built from the plugin
's own Config schema; every field is `volatile`, so edits apply **live** — no restart, no plugin rem

ount.
- **Write-only secret.** The WxPusher `appToken` is declared `role('secret')`: it is stored in

the profile, never returned over the wire, and edited through a path-addressed write.
- **Zero runt
ime dependencies beyond the schema library.** One Host file, one Client file, no build step.
## What triggers a notification
| Event | Source | Detail shown |
| **Session stopped** | `api-session/status` → `running: false` | the folded session title + **the l

ast model reply** (optional) |
| **Exited with an error** | `api-session/error`, `agent/error` | the

error message |
| **Question asked** | `user-questions/request` (observed, then delegated) | the fi

rst question |
| **Approval needed** | `approval/request` (observed, then delegated) | the tool name

t question |
| **Approval needed** | `approval/request` (observed, then delegated) | the tool name |
The WxPusher body for the **stopped detail** (the last model reply) and the **question text** is nev
er truncated and keeps its line breaks, so the phone shows the whole content; browser notifications
still trim to `maxDetailChars` (an OS notification cannot fit long text anyway).
Two filters keep the noise down:

- **`minRunMs`** — a run shorter than this never reports a stop.
- **`stopDebounceMs`** — after the
agent goes idle the Host waits this long; if the session starts running again the report is dropped.
A stop is also suppressed when an error notification for the same session just fired, because that
one is more precise.
`user-questions/request` and `approval/request` are Cordis **waterfalls**: this plugin only observes
them and always delegates with `next()`, so it can never swallow a request meant for another answer
em and always delegates with `next()`, so it can never swallow a request meant for another answerer.
## Requirements
- A DSH Host with the Web surface (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`), i.e. any normal `dsh web` profile. `
ctx.webServer` is used for the notification stream; without it the plugin still pushes to WxPusher b

ut delivers nothing to the browser.
- Node.js ≥ 20.
- A browser that supports the Notification API (

Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari 16+).
- A WxPusher account, only if you want phone pushes.

alls that one, not this plugin — use the repository spec below.

## Configure
Open **Settings → Notifications** (设置 → 通知). The page writes straight into the plugin's profile entr
en **Settings → Notifications** (设置 → 通知). The page writes straight into the plugin's profile entry.
| Field | Default | Meaning |

| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch for both channels. |
[该节后续省略]
## How it works
[代码示例省略，未执行]
- The Host plugin registers two exact routes on `ctx.webServer`: the SSE stream at `/dsh-plugin-noti

fy/events` and the test endpoint at `/dsh-plugin-notify/test`.
- The Client half opens an `EventSour
ce` on the **document-relative** path `dsh-plugin-notify/events`, so it resolves under whatever moun
t served the page and inherits the page's own authentication. `EventSource` reconnects by itself; th

e Host sends a `: ping` heartbeat every 25 s.
- The settings page resolves its namespace from `ctx.c
onfigForms.describe()` — by entry id first, then by the schema it knows it owns — so it keeps workin

g when a profile nests the bundle patch and prefixes the entry id.
- Writes go through `ConfigForm.m
utate()` with **path-addressed** operations, so a secret that the wire never returned is never resta
e()` with **path-addressed** operations, so a secret that the wire never returned is never restated.
## Known limitations
- WxPusher content is composed in Chinese (the WxPusher audience is the phone); the browser notifica

tion is localized through the Harness locale service.
- The "stopped" signal is the agent going idle
. A session that idles mid-conversation between turns is reported once, by design — `stopDebounceMs`

and `minRunMs` are the knobs.
- Nothing is persisted beyond the profile config: no history, no repl

ay of missed notifications.
- The plugin does not create a Remote namespace, so the browser half tal
ks to the Host over the two HTTP routes above rather than over the typed Remote channel.
